entries.definition: The pressed, tested fruit of the olive — the fruit and evidence of the Spirit's work made manifest in proven obedience, stored and burned to make light; not the Spirit Himself.
entries.common_view: Commonly taught: the Holy Spirit — anointing, consecration, and empowering.
entries.citations: (Ex 25:6; 27:20; Prov 21:20; Ezek 36:27; Zech 4:6-14; Matt 25:3-9; 5:16) · see The Fool and the Wise, ch. 20, and The Anointing
